text:
sofia: Heads up — StellarSys agreed to a customer profile + short webinar. Interview scheduled Tues 11:00am PT. Need legal to sign off on two quotes and confirm logo usage. Also want webinar leads routed to 'stellarsys-demo' SDR queue.

ryan: I'll take recording + clips. Will request separate takes of each quote for social assets. Do we need a release form?

tess: Please paste the exact quote candidates here. If they include percent savings, legal will want the supporting snapshot. If not, we can say 'significant reduction' publicly.

mike: For demand gen, recommend a single registration page with utm_campaign=stellarsys-launch. We can webhook to SFDC; queue name: StellarSys Webinar. Also we'll want two 20s promo cuts.

sofia: Candidate quotes from last call (verbatim):
"Switching to Redwood Dedicated lowered tail latency and noticeably improved UX at peak."
"With batching and KV caching, we reduced inference spend materially during our tests."
"Rollout was smooth — our team hit the SLA targets immediately and avoided a planned hotfix."

ryan: Got it. I'll capture all three as separate soundbites and attach consent language to invite.

tess: Flagging the 'reduced inference spend materially' line — legal will ask for numbers. Also note: the customer gave conditional logo approval; they want a separate logo permission signed. We'll use name + quotes only after written confirmation.

mike: Sample webhook payload for ops (we'll mask auth in prod):
POST /hooks/sfdc HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{  "source": "stellarsys-demo",  "email": "{registrant_email}",  "name": "{registrant_name}",  "utm_campaign": "stellarsys-launch",  "target_queue": "StellarSys Webinar" }

sofia: Customer requested embargo: earliest publish 2026-07-20 09:00 PT. Can legal confirm sign-off by 7/16 EOD?

tess: Yes — I'll review quote text today and draft a one-paragraph release for signature. If they won't sign for logo, we'll prepare anonymized copy.

ryan: Calendar invite created. Recording enabled. I'll upload raw files + timestamps after the call.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite "StellarSys case interview" created by ryan for 2026-07-06 11:00 PT.

sofia: Thanks — I'll add a checklist to the launch playbook: legal sign-off, release signed, landing page live + webhook test, assets uploaded. Ping me when done. :rocket:
